problem_or_opportunity.summary: Launch readiness audit of the live ALVIRA surface. One blocker prevents unattended public traffic: the lifetime purchase path returns a server error. A separate high-severity gap means nothing verifies that an interview answer is about the question asked.
problem_or_opportunity.supersedes: codex/launch-readiness-report, audited 2026-08-07 against alvira.ctonew.app, predating roughly 40 merged pull requests (#75-#135)
blockers: P0.2 POST /api/stripe/checkout returns 502 for the lifetime plan; /checkout/lifetime renders 'Checkout needs another try.' The monthly plan works and reaches Stripe correctly.
high: P1.0 Nothing checks topical fit between an answer and the domain it is filed under. askNextQuestion (app.tsx:874) sets currentDomain, handleSend (app.tsx:1107-1202) files the answer there, validateAnswer (-validation.ts:102) accepts domainId but never reads it, and -knowledgeCompiler.ts does not re-classify. Correct when the user answers on-topic; silently wrong and unflagged when they drift.
P1.1 /api/bridge/context returns 401 for an authenticated user on every /bridge load.

P1.2 No page links to /bridge in either signed-in or signed-out state; signed out it 307s to /app. The 'Use elsewhere' nav item points to /integrations instead. AGENTS.md names /bridge the canonical Bridge UI.
medium: P1.3 React error #418 hydration mismatch on every /app load.
P2.2 The 'Reflect' nav item points to the legacy /meos route.
verified_working: All 26 page routes return 200 with no broken internal links.
Guest interview runs end to end without an account, with no failed network requests.
Compilation succeeds in roughly six seconds and produces seven .md representations plus a .zip. The 2026-08-07 P0.1 compilation hang does not reproduce.
Login, session persistence, and the returning-user Context prompt all work.
Authenticated navigation is complete; /build-brief is correctly auth-gated per #134.
Footer legal complete: Privacy, Terms, Refunds, Support, Data.
Monthly checkout reaches Stripe with the correct price and prefilled email.
problem_or_opportunity.withdrawn_finding: An earlier revision recorded a critical P0.1 claiming interview answers are assigned to a fixed category sequence in arrival order rather than by content. Source tracing disproved it: assignment follows the asked domain. The original evidence was a scripted run that sent fixed answers without reading each question, which manufactures mismatches under a correct design. Withdrawn and replaced by P1.0.

originating_signal.definition_of_done_given_by_owner: Clean end-to-end workflow, every landing page reachable by an active link at the applicable occasion, interview flow works and provides context successfully, and enough confidence to point a stranger at the site.
originating_signal.method: Headless Chromium with native sandbox enabled at 1440x900, measured after document.fonts.ready. Unauthenticated crawl of all 26 page routes plus an authenticated pass using the AGENTS.md free-tier smoke account.

priority.rationale: P0.2 disables half the purchase surface and is unambiguous. The interview finding was reduced from critical to high after source tracing showed categorisation is correct for on-topic answers. Final priority remains the owner's call.

evidence.name: answer-domain-assignment
evidence.finding: app.tsx:874 sets currentDomain from gap detection; app.tsx:1107-1202 files the answer under it; -validation.ts:102 accepts domainId but never references it in the function body; -knowledgeCompiler.ts:42-47 groups by stored assignment without re-classification.

evidence.name: category-misassignment-black-box
evidence.finding: Guest and authenticated scripted runs appeared to show positional assignment. Withdrawn: the scripts sent fixed answers without tracking the question asked, so mismatch was expected under a correct design.

evidence.name: lifetime-checkout-502
evidence.finding: /checkout/lifetime renders 'Checkout needs another try.'; /api/stripe/checkout returns 502. /checkout/pro-monthly redirects to a cs_live_ Stripe session at $20.00/month.

evidence.name: bridge-context-401
evidence.finding: GET /api/bridge/context returns 401 with a valid authenticated session.

evidence.name: route-reachability
evidence.finding: 26/26 routes return 200. /bridge and /bridge/connect have zero inbound links in either auth state. /account, /dashboard, /history, /interview, /reset-password are correctly unlinked for signed-out visitors.

evidence.name: hydration-error
evidence.finding: Minified React error #418 on every /app load; absent on marketing routes.

desired_outcome.statement: A stranger can be pointed at the live site and complete the intended path end to end, receiving context that is accurately categorized, with every offered purchase path functional.
observable_change: An interview answer that does not address the domain being asked is detected and surfaced, rather than filed under that domain at full confidence.
Both /checkout/pro-monthly and /checkout/lifetime reach Stripe without a 5xx.
/bridge is linked from the authenticated navigation and reachable as a customer surface.

constraints.product_direction_status: Post-Revision 11 working hypothesis. Findings are verified observations; severity rankings and recommendations require owner ratification.
repository_local_rules: Branch from latest main as codex/<short-task-name>; never commit or push to main.
Open a draft pull request and satisfy the AGENTS.md Merge Gate.
Free-tier smoke account acceptance testing comes before owner-profile verification.
Never store, commit, print, or document the smoke account password or tokens.
constraints.live_stripe_warning: The working checkout path opens a cs_live_ session. Automated smoke tests should use a Stripe test-mode path so runs cannot create real sessions.
constraints.browser_execution: Rendered verification for these findings is produced by the owner or another authorized surface rather than by the implementing agent, because the findings were gathered outside this repository and re-running them is not part of the implementation task. A control-plane policy governing agent browser execution is in progress in tk-ap/agent-os but is not yet published, so no policy citation is made here. Revisit this constraint when that work lands.

human_oversight.basis: Launch readiness is an owner decision. Agents surface evidence; they do not declare a product launch-ready.

acceptance_criteria: validateAnswer performs a topical-fit check using the domainId it already receives, and a low-fit answer is surfaced to the user rather than filed silently.
A regression test covers the drifted-answer case: an answer that does not address the asked domain is flagged rather than recorded at full confidence.
/checkout/pro-monthly continues to reach Stripe with the correct price.
/bridge is linked from authenticated navigation and does not redirect signed-out visitors to /app without explanation.
No React hydration error is logged on /app.
/brand-preview is not reachable by an anonymous visitor.
The 'Reflect' navigation item points at its canonical route.
All page routes still return 200 after the changes.
Free-tier smoke account acceptance passes before owner-profile verification.
Owner has reviewed and accepted the launch decision.
